en.Olá, %s,\n\nRecebemos uma solicitação pa:
Hello %s,

We received a request to reset the password of your IABill account,
linked to the company %s.

To choose a new password, go to:

%s

If you did not request this reset, you can safely ignore this email -
your current password remains valid.

The IABill team
en.Olá, %s,\n\nSua conta na plataforma IABi:
Hello %s,

Your account on the IABill platform has been created. To confirm your email, go to:

%s

If you did not request this registration, you can ignore this email.

The IABill team
en.Olá, %s,\n\nVocê foi convidado para aces:
Hello %s,

You have been invited to access IABill as part of the %s account.

To set your password and activate your access, click the link below:

%s

If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

The IABill team
en.Se existir uma conta com esse e-mail, vo: If an account exists with this email, you will receive instructions to reset your password.
